grants.description: Verify your identity as the parent or guardian of the child
grants.purpose: To confirm you have parental responsibility and are authorised to apply for a school place

grants.description: Provide your child's personal information for the application
grants.purpose: To identify the child and assess eligibility based on age and residence

grants.description: Share your child's current school attendance record if applicable
grants.purpose: For secondary transfer applications, to verify current education status

grants.description: Share information about siblings at preferred schools
grants.purpose: Siblings at the preferred school may increase admission priority under school admission criteria

grants.description: Share your ranked school preferences with the named schools and local authority
grants.purpose: Schools and the local authority need your preferences to allocate places according to admission criteria

grants.description: Share medical, social, or other supporting information if applicable
grants.purpose: To support your application if there are exceptional medical or social reasons for a specific school

revocation.mechanism: Contact your local authority admissions team or withdraw through your online account
revocation.effect: Application will be withdrawn. You can reapply but may miss the deadline for coordinated offers.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot rank school preferences without your explicit confirmation of each preference in order. Agent cannot submit supporting medical/social evidence on your behalf without your review. Agent cannot accept or decline a school place offer.
